messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the metering postmortem — can we capture owners and concrete timelines for the ingestion-delay remediation and invoice corrections?

ajay: I can own the ingestion-side fixes. Root cause recap: delayed Kafka consumer commits during burst windows meant ~12-18% of tokens were not written to the metering topic for ~3 hours on 2026-03-18.

lina: From billing: we flagged 46 affected invoices so far. Need dates + amt estimate to prepare credit memos. I can draft once we have a final corrected token dump.

tom: I'll add the missing telemetry to the pipeline today — capture per-partition commit latency + message lag histogram. Plan: small schema change in metrics, then roll a canary. ETA 2026-03-30.

maria: Action list idea: 1) produce corrected token counts + reconciliation (owner: ajay) 2) billing credits plan (owner: lina) 3) pipeline metrics + alerting (owner: tom) 4) customer comms + FAQs (owner: sara). Agree?

ajay: Agree. Details: for (1) I'll run a one-time backfill that reads raw events from S3 + replays through the metering translator to produce corrected counts. Command I plan to use:

```
# safe dry run
python tools/replay_metering.py --source s3://redwood-ingest/raw/2026-03-18 --dry-run
# then real run
python tools/replay_metering.py --source s3://... --output s3://redwood-metering/corrected/2026-03-18
```

ajay: Backfill ETA: start 2026-03-25, finish 2026-03-26 (depending on cluster slot). I will add a post-run checksum + diff report.

lina: Once we have the corrected counts, give me a CSV with: account_id, original_tokens, corrected_tokens, delta_tokens, charge_per_token. I'll calculate credits and patch invoices.

tom: For alerts: adding an alert when consumer lag > 5k messages for 5m + >0.5s commit latency for 3 sequential windows. I'll add Grafana dashboard panels.

sara: I'll own customer comms. Draft timeline: initial outreach by 2026-03-29 with explanation + expected credit timing. Will prepare templates for support.

maria: Great — can everyone add their JIRA ticket numbers here once created? I'll track in the postmortem follow-up doc.

ajay: JIRA: INFRA-9876 (ingestion backfill) — added. I'll link the replay logs and diff artifacts in that ticket.

lina: JIRA: BILL-4521 (invoice corrections/credits). I'll attach a sample credit memo and spreadsheet.

tom: JIRA: MTR-2043 (metrics + alerting) — will include new dashboard links.

sara: JIRA: COMM-1102 (customer comms + support scripts).

maria: Noted recurring pattern from postmortem: similar lag incidents on 2025-11-12 and 2026-01-07 but smaller. Suggest we add a quarterly review of our ingestion SLOs and retention of consumer-lag traces. Propose recurring calendar invite — quarterly. Thoughts?

ajay: +1. Also propose a runbook addition: automatic temporary reroute to secondary consumer when lag > threshold. I'll prototype after the backfill.

lina: For billing ops: need a cross-check step in process: billing should get an automated alert when we mark a production reconciliation as complete so we don't send credits too early.

tom: FYI to eng-sre: I found a subtle race when partitions rebalance during high commit latency — pushing a fix that reduces concurrent commit workers from 8 -> 4 as a safe short-term mitigation. Deploying canary now.

incidents-bot: Deploy started by ajay on infra-canary-3. Status: rolling.

maria: Thanks all. Recap deadlines: backfill done by 2026-03-26 (ajay), corrected CSV to billing by 2026-03-27 (ajay -> lina), credit memos drafted by 2026-03-29 (lina), customer outreach by 2026-03-29 (sara), metrics/alerts live by 2026-03-30 (tom). Please flag if any of those slip.

ajay: Ack, will update INFRA-9876 if timeline changes.

lina: Ack. I'll queue support templates once I have the CSV.

sara: I'll draft comms tomorrow and share in the ticket.

tom: Canary shows reduced commit error rate in preliminary logs. If stable, I'll roll to prod after 1h observation.

maria: One more note — please include in each ticket an estimate of how many customers are affected and a short rationale for credit amount. Finance needs that for audit.

ajay: Will add: affected_count=46, estimate_tokens_delta_total=1.2e9, note=burst consumer commit stalls during GC window.

lina: Will include finance audit fields in BILL-4521.

maria: OK closing the thread for now — will follow up in the postmortem doc and calendar invite. Thanks :thumbsup: 

ajay: Thanks everyone.

sara: thanks :heart:
